chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan al-Jammal, who said:
I prayed behind Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام for some days, and he used to perform qunut in every salat (prayer), whether he recited aloud in it or did not recite aloud in it.

key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, in following the Imam in prayer

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام perform qunut in every salat (prayer), including both audible and silent prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the consistent practice of Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام regarding qunut in salat (prayer). It indicates that qunut was performed in every salat (prayer), whether it was one recited aloud or silently, making it relevant to jurisprudential discussions on the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of qunut.
